blocks.html: ROBINSONS LAND CORPORATION (RLC) BREAKS NEW GROUND FOR ITS 5TH OFFICE BUILDING IN THE ORTIGAS CENTRAL BUSINESS DISTRICT

Robinsons Land Corporation strengthens its lead as the biggest and most preferred corporate landlord in the Ortigas area with the start of the construction of its fifth office building in the Ortigas Central Business District following Cyberscape Alpha, Cyberscape Beta, Robinsons Equitable Tower and Galleria Corporate Center.
Present during its ceremonial groundbreaking were (L-R) Arch. Jose Siao Ling, Owner and President, Jose Siao Ling and Associates; Engr. Roel Bolaños, Managing Partner, Andres Balanak Bolaños and Associates; Engr. Manny Arce, VP for Project Management, Robinsons Land Corporation; Faraday Go, General Manager, Robinsons Land Corporation Office Buildings Division; Mr. Danilo Tamayo, President, DDT Konstract Inc. ; and Mr. Victor Buencamino, General Manager, Ortigas Center Association Incorporated (OCAI).

Cyberscape Gamma is a 37-storey office development located right beside RLC’s Cyberscape Beta along Topaz and Ruby roads. It will be interconnected to the fully completed Cyberscape Beta at the ground and mezzanine floors which will also feature various retail and dining compliments as well as some service shops.
The building will be equipped with high-speed elevators, 100 percent back-up power with N+1 provision, multiple telecom providers as well as an advanced security, fire safety and building management system.

Cyberscape Gamma is accessible through EDSA, C-5 and Ortigas Avenue via all major modes of transport which makes commuting easy for employees. Support facilities such as major shopping malls, international hotel chains, residential apartments, hospital, schools and events venues are available in the vicinity.

Robinsons Offices, RLC’s office buildings division currently has ten (10) completed office projects located in key cities such as Pasig, Mandaluyong, Makati, and Cebu. Cybergate Gamma will be the 14th addition to the office portfolio of Robinsons Offices.
